decision: A fork that is a whole redesign becomes a named layout inside its format; a brand pack picks it by name (formats.<f>.layout) and supplies values, never code
why: IU thumbnail v3 and the IU social scene graph are new designs, not recolours; lifting them as layouts keeps exact parity for every brand while the engine (parser, paths, pool, Chrome, CLI, contract) is shared

decision: Keep two banner designs, strip-centre (OBA) and strip-corner (IU), both brand-neutral, instead of one merged template
why: each fork's PNG and SVG already drift apart (IU glow 0.34 in the PNG vs 0.30 in the SVG; the OBA SVG ignores brand text colours), so a byte-parity merge would encode those quirks as fake brand values; brand-neutral designs give the real win: a new brand picks a design in one file

decision: Golden runs see the shared photo pool: a scratch fork is given the pool files it lacks, and the report names the ones its cases used
why: zoom-banner's Sep 17 headshots were deleted from its working tree, so the fork drew a monogram where Stencil drew the photo; no two pools hold different bytes under one name, so supplying only fills gaps

decision: Shared fix: a hidden PACE plate is display:none in the corner design
why: the IU template left the hidden img laid out in the header row; unreachable for IU (CE line required) but it would shift any brand without PACE

decision: VET banner SVG now takes VET's own muted text, line and pill colours, matching its PNG; logo layer named VBI
why: the OBA SVG twin hard-coded OBA's colours while the PNG used VET's; no real VET banner input exists, so there is no parity case to hold

decision: The Sept 17 Referral Growth deck (the design note's deck reference) fails g-slides' own overflow check today: slide 7's stat label collides with the role line; Stencil fails identically, and the parity runner now counts identical failures as matching behaviour
why: a content problem in the deck input, not an engine difference; the owner fixes the copy, then its PNGs and PDF build in both

decision: The deck moves verbatim except lib/paths.mjs (same exports over core) and a brand shim; text and metrics stay in formats/deck until a second format measures text
why: one adapted module carries the whole re-wiring, so 13 deck files stay provably identical to g-slides; rule of two (plan A8)

decision: g-slides/host-background imported ../../panel-kit/lib/brands.mjs (the canonical panel-kit repo), a cross-repo reach the design note did not list; golden runs copy panel-kit into the scratch tree, and Stencil reads the deck brand shim instead
why: found when the background golden failed with module not found

decision: The deck's raised dots grid is a documented deck-scoped token in the OBA pack (formats.deck.tokens.dotsGrid); the deck reads it through the brand, geometry's DOTS is the fallback
why: the design note's step 4: a brand-scoped override expressible without forking, documented where declared; OBA deck parity unchanged (51 exact)

decision: IU gets a deck design that is colours only (deck type, no PACE plate); the deck embeds SVG logos now
why: proves a second brand renders through the deck without forking; a real IU deck design (Inter Display, EB Garamond, PACE) is the owner's call after the look

decision: d-sign verdict on Stencil's public surfaces (shape/errors/naming/docs, after fixes): brand pack 9/8/8/8, brand registry 8/8/8/8, CLI 9/9/9/8, output contract 7/8/9/9, GUI 8/9/9/8
why: fixed: id and label stated once per pack; packs validated against the format registry's design names; CLI through symlinks; formats declare value flags; GUI refuses a split workspace. Open: the contract module is an assertion spec, moved code still names its own outputs (tests catch drift); converge when a fork retires

decision: The classic (OBA) thumbnail PNG is the capture two separate browser sessions agree on (a third breaks a tie); knob pngAgreement in formats/thumb/layouts/classic/index.mjs
why: the fork's template loads one variable Inter file from Google Fonts for four weights, and under load Chrome lays some glyphs out 1/64 px differently (the fork did it 2 times in 18 with six parallel renders); local fonts would fix the root but change pixels, so that waits for the owner's look

decision: Thumbnails carry no brand object: the pack reaches them only as data (design name, the frozen SVG prefix, the IU ground mode), and a pack whose prefix does not match its design is a validation error
why: neither thumbnail fork had a brand registry or put one in its sidecar, so adding one would break parity; the twins hard-code OBA- and IU- prefixes

decision: Format CLIs keep going past one invalid input in a multi-input run and return exit 1 when a PNG fails (the forks quit at the first bad input and only warned on a failed PNG)
why: one bad episode should not hide the other 81 results, and a failed render must fail the exit code that scripts and the GUI branch on

decision: Social shared modules: cutout.mjs and portrait-fit.mjs are the IU copies (exported rawCutout; sharp from Stencil only), geometry.mjs the OBA copy (only comments differ); no differing line was a brand value
why: triage of every OBA vs IU diff line, proven by parity on all 52 posts (316 files exact)

decision: What the two social forks did differently (default and drawable formats, a required CE line, sidecar naming, who cuts out speaker photos, IU copy lint) are layout rules in formats/social/gen.mjs LAYOUTS, not pack options
why: they describe what each design can draw, and the lane could not edit packs; moving them to formats.social.options is a follow-up

decision: IU's QR selection serves both social designs: an OBA post that names a person but no QR now gets one matched; no real OBA post changes (each names its QR explicitly)
why: one brand-neutral rule instead of two; parity unchanged

decision: The social PNG renderers relaunch Chrome once and retry the canvas if Chrome crashes mid-post
why: Chrome crashed once mid-run under load from a parallel lane; tested by killing the renderer's Chrome mid-render: every PNG still written, byte-identical

decision: When an image differs, the parity runner re-renders that case through the fork up to 3 times and accepts a byte-identical fork render, replacing the cached golden and listing the file apart
why: thumbnail ep028's cached golden was a rare variant the fork made under load; three quiet fork re-renders all equalled Stencil's PNG

decision: Open: the moved social designs still key on brand ids inside their own code (the classic template's data-brand OBA_LIGHT CSS, the scene's theme table by brand id); making them brand-neutral like the banner (a scene mode option, light tokens) is follow-up work behind the same parity gate
why: kept verbatim for byte parity; format-level code tests no brand id

decision: The social classic and thumbnail renderers give a page.goto navigation timeout, like a Chrome crash, one fresh browser and one more try
why: the final parity pass lost Promo_05 landscape to a stalled Google Fonts request holding DOMContentLoaded past 30s; the retry is the same procedure, so it cannot produce a PNG the fork could not

decision: The Oct 22 thumbnail labels each card with the company only, and the Oct 22 deck omits speaker websites and the offer slide's QR; the deck's offer wording is a draft from the sales funnel note
why: Ben's role plus company is too long for a three-card label (it truncated), and his website is too long for the closing slide's three-name row; no IU MSM short link exists yet for the slide QR (event note, Pre-panel task); the host has not approved offer wording; content is sourced only from the vault's Oct 22 partner details and funnel notes
